title: Pressure-Volume Loop Shape as a Fatigue Health Indicator for Pressure-Only Proprioception in Shared-Manifold Soft Grippers: A Simulation Study
description: Simulation-only study of cycle-resolved pressure-volume loop shape as a fatigue health indicator and trigger for pressure-only proprioception recalibration in shared-manifold soft pneumatic grippers.
